name.text: Approximate percentile of a distribution presented as a histogram (STACK)

questiontext.text:
The histogram below shows the heights of plants measured in an experiment.

[[jsxgraph width="400px" height="400px"]] var xmin = {#xmin#}; var xmax = {#xmax#}; var bounds = {#bounds#}; var heights = {#plotheights#}; /* Leave half a class width between the histogram and each side. */ var xleft = xmin - 0.5; var xright = xmax + 0.5; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [xleft - 0.15, 6, xright + 0.15, -0.9], axis: false, keepaspectratio: true, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false }); /* Horizontal guide lines. */ for (var y = 1; y <= 5; y++) { board.create('segment', [[xleft, y], [xright, y]], { strokeWidth: 1, strokeOpacity: 0.35, fixed: true, highlight: false } ); } /* Draw histogram bars. */ for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) { var vertices = [ [bounds[i], 0], [bounds[i + 1], 0], [bounds[i + 1], heights[i]], [bounds[i], heights[i]] ]; board.create('polygon', vertices, { fillOpacity: 0.5, fixed: true, highlight: false, vertices: { visible: false, fixed: true, highlight: false }, borders: { strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false } }); } /* Horizontal axis. */ board.create('segment', [[xleft, 0], [xright, 0]], { strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false } ); /* Vertical axis, separated from the first bar. */ board.create('segment', [[xleft, 0], [xleft, 5.5]], { strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false } ); /* Tick marks and labels at the class boundaries. */ for (var i = 0; i < bounds.length; i++) { var x = bounds[i]; board.create('segment', [[x, -0.08], [x, 0.08]], { strokeWidth: 1, fixed: true, highlight: false } ); board.create('text', [x, -0.18, x.toFixed(1)], { anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 16, fixed: true, highlight: false } ); } /* Horizontal axis label. */ board.create('text', [(xleft + xright) / 2, -0.58, 'Height (cm)'], { anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 16, fixed: true, highlight: false } ); [[/jsxgraph]]

Estimate the \(75\)th percentile of the plant heights: [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] cm [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
The \(75\)th percentile is the height below which approximately \(75\%\) of the observations lie.

Starting from the left of the histogram, consider the area of each bar and accumulate these areas until you reach about \(75\%\) of the total area. The \(75\)th percentile lies within the bar where this occurs. Estimate how far through that bar you need to go to reach \(75\%\).

For this histogram, the \(75\)th percentile is approximately \({@dispdp(ta,1)@}\) cm.

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text: Good estimation, but you could be improved.

falsefeedback.text: Your estimate is not close enough.
